result.brief: 提出 HermiteVFI，用每像素三次 Hermite 连续轨迹替代查询时刻光流重采样，端点位移固定位置、学习潜端点导数控制内部路径，并分析多时刻监督的秩条件。
result.reason: Proposes explicit continuous per-pixel cubic Hermite trajectory representation for two-frame video frame interpolation, a motion representation contribution directly serving video generation/interpolation.
